Declared per-board rule (d) is strict (< 1 cent of the exact pro-rata share). Production's stated rule rounds each per-pot award and moves each player's penny difference onto that player's largest entry (HandController winnersByBoardPostRake, 2026-09-04), so per-board entries can sit 1 to 2.5 cents from the exact share while the player's total is exact. These are reported as MISMATCH under the declaration; the post-declaration description is given separately and changes no verdict.
Deductions (e) use the hand's own captured configuration; 15 old rows have no captured configuration (unknown). Rule history before the capture existed is not reconstructed.

Contribution replay: raise/all-in amounts are resolved against the next captured invested totals; 2,672 last actions with no later capture were resolved by recorded pot_size (only when exactly one reading equals it). Horse RIT verdicts are engine decisions, not Horse-brain decisions: the private journal has no record of them. The check compares recorded answers with the engine's stated deterministic rule; it says nothing about whether that rule is good poker.
